Dappled gold light falling in soft coins through the high canopy, drifting slowly across the moss and the beast's flank.
God-rays lancing down through drifting fog between the great trunks, the beast half-lit at the edge of the beams.
Cool moonlight silvering the clearing, the beast pale and luminous against the deep blue shadows of the trees.
Low warm dawn gilding the mist between the trunks, the light amber and thick as honey on every wet surface.
Deep blue-hour dusk settling into the canopy, the first fireflies sparking gold in the dim understorey around the beast.
Soft overcast light filtering through the canopy, green and even, no shadows, the whole forest glowing from within like jade.
Late-gold sun raking low through the trunks at a long angle, striping the ground with warm light and deep shadow.
A single shaft of light descending through a gap in the canopy, spotlighting the beast in the surrounding gloom.
Starlight over a wide clearing, the sky deep indigo above, the beast silver-grey and still in the open dark.
Pale first light seeping through frost-rimed branches, everything cold and luminous, the air itself faintly white with cold breath.
Autumn late-afternoon sun burning copper through thinning leaves, the light warm and melancholy, the ground thick with gold.
Thin winter light falling flat and blue through bare branches, no warmth in it, only a clean cold clarity.
Storm-light before rain, greenish and strange, the forest darkened and electric, every leaf standing out with eerie sharpness.
Midsummer noon pressing down through dense canopy, deep shade below with rare blazing coins of light on the earth.
Reflected water-light rippling across the undersides of branches, liquid and shifting, the beast's coat shimmering in the moving pattern.
Rose-gold dusk caught in the high canopy while the forest floor below falls into early shadow and deep stillness.
Moonrise through the tree line, one broad silver beam cutting low across the clearing through curling ground mist.
Fog-diffused morning light with no clear source, the whole forest luminous and grey-white, distance swallowed in soft erasure.
Wildfire glow on the far horizon, the near trees lit orange and flickering from below, the beast gilded in alarm.
Blue pre-dawn silence, the forest not quite dark and not yet light, shapes emerging slowly from the dissolving dark.
Canopy broken by a fallen giant, raw sunlight flooding in hard and golden onto the bright clearing of new ferns.
Thundercloud shadow racing across the canopy, the light dropping fast and cold, the beast lifting its head at the change.
Warm lantern-light lost under the vast dark canopy, a small gold pool with the beast at its edge, watching.
Deep winter moonlight on snow between the trunks, the shadows blue and crisp, the beast's breath rising in white plumes.
Long-evening light slanting gold through forest edge, the outermost trees lit brilliantly, the interior a soft and layered dusk.
